notes.subject: il-
notes.rationale: Maltese article supplied before 'Ħallieq'; Hebrew עושהו has no article, only the suffix 'his'.

notes.subject: il-Ħallieq
notes.rationale: עושהו literally 'il-Fattur' (his Maker/doer); 'Ħallieq' (creator) is the natural Maltese for the maker of a people.

notes.subject: jiekol
notes.rationale: ואכלה literally 'and it will eat' the citadels; fire 'devouring' rendered with the same verb 'jiekol' to keep the picture.

notes.subject: בעריו / ארמנתיה
notes.rationale: Singular 'his cities' after two subjects, then feminine 'her palaces'; Hebrew shifts referent — kept literally as 'tiegħu/tagħha'.

translation: U Jisrael nesa ⟨את⟩ ⟨il-Ħallieq⟩ tiegħu, u bena tempji; u Juda żied bliet iffortifikati; jien nibgħat nar fuq blietu, u jiekol l-imgħolqin tagħha.
